SOURCE: ARBITER-V2.md, sections 1.11 and 1.15. Two places where the independent arbiter ruled AGAINST this certification. Both re-checked here and both conceded.

CORRECTION_1_THE_EFFECT_FLOOR_EQUIVALENC.WHAT_I_WROTE: p5b: 'on this sample the floor is reproduced EXACTLY by a plain incidence threshold of 0.41: 0 of 40 cells disagree', and 'T in {5,6,7} give the identical partition, so the number 5 is not selected by the data'.
CORRECTION_1_THE_EFFECT_FLOOR_EQUIVALENC.WHAT_THE_ARBITER_MEASURED: on a 533-cell sample (mine was 282) no incidence threshold reproduces the floor; the best is 0.251 with 12 of 86 disagreements, and only T = 5 of the 71 integers tried gives the shipped partition.
CORRECTION_1_THE_EFFECT_FLOOR_EQUIVALENC.WHY_WE_DIFFER: sample size. My sweep ran 3 crops over 11 dates in 2026 plus one calendar date in each prior season; the arbiter's covers more cells. A partition that looks degenerate on 282 cells separates on 533. The equivalence I found is a property of my sample, not of the floor.
CORRECTION_1_THE_EFFECT_FLOOR_EQUIVALENC.CONCEDED: The claim 'the floor is a disguised incidence threshold' is WITHDRAWN. So is 'T in {5,6,7} are interchangeable' as a general statement - it holds on my sample and not on a wider one.
WHAT_STILL_STANDS_UNCHANGED: EFFECT_FLOOR = NOT_PROVED, which was the verdict either way.

MIN_POSITIVE_SITES is absent from the module's own declared parameter list, absent from the emitted PARAMS block, and absent from sensitivity()'s 135-point grid - so gate F, whose whole job is measuring parameter dependence, has never varied it.
0 of the surviving HIGHER calls are in the 2026 season, on either sample.
the original p5 test (0 fails open, 0 fails closed) was a tautology and remains withdrawn.
CORRECTION_1_THE_EFFECT_FLOOR_EQUIVALENC.NET_EFFECT: the floor comes out slightly BETTER than my retraction said - the value 5 is more special than I found - and still NOT PROVED.

CORRECTION_2_PROVINCES_DO_NOT_STAY_UNKNO.WHAT_I_WROTE: p9 TEST4: 'five of five unmonitored provinces stayed UNKNOWN and none acquired a neighbour's class', offered as evidence that geography is not inherited.
CORRECTION_2_PROVINCES_DO_NOT_STAY_UNKNO.WHAT_THE_ARBITER_FOUND: those five provinces are ABSENT FROM THE OUTPUT ENTIRELY, not published as UNKNOWN.

RE_CHECKED_HERE.on_2026-09-06_the_five_that_DO_appear: all five carry n_sites = 0 and STATE = UNKNOWN_NO_DATA
RE_CHECKED_HERE.on_2026-05-15: one of the five (Siena) carries n_sites = 0 and STATE = UNKNOWN_NO_DATA

CORRECTION_2_PROVINCES_DO_NOT_STAY_UNKNO.THE_PRECISE_STATEMENT: current_pressure builds its province list from whatever rows exist. A province with rows in the archive but none inside the window is correctly published UNKNOWN_NO_DATA. A province the programme never monitors at all never appears. There is no fixed universe of provinces in the output.
CORRECTION_2_PROVINCES_DO_NOT_STAY_UNKNO.WHY_IT_MATTERS: the two halves of the claim are different. NO INHERITANCE is TRUE and I confirm it: 0 provinces acquired a neighbour's class, in any case, on any date tried. But EVERY PROVINCE IS ACCOUNTED FOR is FALSE, and a reader cannot tell 'we looked and found nothing' from 'we never looked here'. The olive and vine cases read 8/10 and 0/10 only because those archives happen to cover all ten Tuscan provinces; the wheat case reads N/5 and Tuscany has ten.
CORRECTION_2_PROVINCES_DO_NOT_STAY_UNKNO.CONCEDED: p9's sentence is corrected. Geography is not INVENTED; it is also not COMPLETE.

WHAT_THE_ARBITER_DID_NOT_OVERTURN: Every other finding in this certification that it re-ran, it reproduced - including the clean-checkout drift, the denominator join defect, gate J being unable to pass, gate B passing with its cutoff removed, gate D passing while missing data is published as zero, gate E passing under a fixed different file order, the engine publishing a class from the fungicide column, the wheat case measuring var 372 Intensita' Oidio, and all eight published olive provinces reading LOWER_THAN_USUAL.
AND_ONE_IT_MADE_STRONGER: ADAMA_PRODUCT_RELATION = NOT_FOUND. p10 stated it over the 3 products the handoff names. The arbiter measured the wider reading in italia-portale/client/italy-handoff-v21.js: 0 of 2,030 label-use pairs over 102 products name the olive fruit fly, and the single pair touching the olive crop is a herbicide. The verdict is unchanged and the evidence behind it is 34 times wider than p10 claimed.
